Recruitment

Come and Join Us!

Join RIVAL ITS and become part of a multidisciplinary team that builds world class competition robots through innovation, collaboration, and strong engineering culture.

Through this internship recruitment, you will gain hands-on experience, practical knowledge, and exposure to real competition projects while growing your technical and professional skills.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

  1. 1

    Incoming undergraduate student (S1/D4) at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), Class of 2026.

  2. 2

    Demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and embrace new challenges.

  3. 3

    Able to work collaboratively in a team and perform well under pressure.

  4. 4

    Committed, responsible, and dedicated to contributing to RIVAL ITS.

  5. 5

    Willing to participate in all recruitment stages and internship programs.

TECHNICAL DIVISIONS

Mechanical

Mission

Design and manufacture durable, efficient, and competition-ready robotic structures.

Focus

Robot mechanical design and manufacturing.

Responsibilities
  • Design robot structures and mechanisms.
  • Manufacture and assemble mechanical components.
  • Operate manufacturing equipment safely.
  • Conduct testing and improve mechanical performance.
Expected Skills
  • CAD Engineering (Fusion 360, Autodesk Inventor, etc.)
  • Manufacturing (bandsaw, drill, conventional/CNC machines, etc.)

Electrical

Mission

Develop reliable electronic and embedded systems that power the robot's performance.

Focus

Hardware and electronic system development.

Responsibilities
  • Assemble electronic components, wiring, and power systems.
  • Develop and integrate embedded systems using microcontrollers.
  • Perform hardware testing and troubleshooting.
  • Integrate sensors and actuators into the robot.
Expected Skills
  • Circuit Design
  • Wiring & Soldering
  • Arduino, ESP32, STM32
  • Electronics Troubleshooting

Programming

Mission

Develop intelligent software that enables the robot to perform autonomously and efficiently.

Focus

Software development and autonomous robot control.

Responsibilities
  • Develop robot control systems.
  • Implement computer vision and sensor processing.
  • Create navigation and automation algorithms.
  • Test, debug, and optimize software performance.
Expected Skills
  • C/C++
  • Python
  • ROS (Robot Operating System)
  • OpenCV
  • Git & Version Control

NON-TECHNICAL DIVISIONS

Creative & Design

The Creative & Design division handles the creation and design of all visual content related to the team, including videos, graphics, and social media management. It builds a positive and professional image of the team for public consumption.

Requirements
  • Proficiency in graphic design software.
  • Experience with video production and editing tools.
  • Creative mindset with a good eye for visual aesthetics.
  • Ability to create engaging content to promote the team's image.

Sponsorship & Public Relations

The Sponsorship & Public Relations division manages events and agendas involving the team, maintains relationships with external stakeholders, and ensures effective public communication through social media. This division is also responsible for securing sponsorships and ensuring agreed-upon sponsorship benefits are delivered.

Requirements
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for external relations.
  • Ability to negotiate and secure sponsorship deals.
  • Enthusiasm for networking and maintaining external relations.
  • Understanding of social media platforms for brand communication.

Administration & Finance

The Administration division is responsible for organizing the team's timeline and agenda, managing general team needs, archiving important documents, handling correspondence, and completing the paperwork required for competitions.

Requirements
  • Able to handle and archive documents efficiently.
  • Familiar with managing schedules and team activities.
  • Able to manage official correspondence and maintain confidentiality.
  • Committed and able to work under pressure to meet deadlines.

Required Documents

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) (ATS or Creative Format).

  • Motivation Letter (minimum 500 words) containing:

    1. 1.Self-introduction
    2. 2.What you know about RIVAL ITS
    3. 3.Your motivation for joining RIVAL ITS
    4. 4.The contributions and innovations you can bring to your chosen division

  • Portfolio (Optional but Recommended)
